sourceEvidence.note: Public same-name dealer listings confirm identity leads, but no source-logo raster was reviewed as a suitable edit target in this proposal pass. If a recognizable published logo is confirmed, preserve it instead of replacing it with this concept.

generation.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original independent automotive dealer logo proposal, transparent PNG master
Primary request: a distinctive professional brand identity for the EXACT business text "Wyze Motors Ltd", rendered only once.
Identity idea: create a clever but understated bespoke angular W emblem subtly suggesting a forward road convergence through negative space, WITHOUT literal steering wheel or car outline. Wordmark "Wyze Motors Ltd" alongside in exquisite geometric sans typography.
Style: premium British automotive retail, precise vector-like flat artwork, confident clean letterforms, careful spacing, simple silhouette.
Palette: deep midnight navy and cool desaturated teal, flat solid inks; no gradients or gloss.
Composition: horizontal lockup, emblem on left and wordmark on right, modest safe transparent margins, legible in mobile website header; icon able to stand alone at 32px.
Constraints: exact text "Wyze Motors Ltd", genuine transparent alpha; no slogans, no additional words, no stock badges, no mockup, no background rectangle or checkerboard, no watermark, no 3D, no car clipart. Independent proposal, not an official brand claim.

holdReasons: Concept not compared with recognizable same-business published logo
No separate 32/48/64px compact mark and on-dark/accent exports
No maintained source-pack hashes or six-template screenshot review
